analysis.summaryJa: 受動文は行為を受ける対象を主語にし、be動詞＋過去分詞で組み立てる。be動詞が時制・疑問・否定を担当し、過去分詞が「〜される」内容を示す。by＋行為者は必須ではなく、誰が行ったかが重要な場合だけ加える。行為者を伏せると内容が広く言われる一般論の印象も作れる。
grammarPoints: 受け手を主語にする受動文
be動詞による現在・過去・未来・完了
過去分詞による受動内容
必要な場合だけ加えるby＋行為者
be動詞を前置する受動疑問
It is said / believed thatの一般化
visualEvidence: BEの薬瓶とPAST PARTICIPLE結晶が受動公式を作っている
主語の大瓶が行為を受ける対象と表示されている
BYカプセルが任意の追加要素として横に置かれている
群衆の影が発言者を隠した一般論を示す
四つの例が行為者あり・なし・一般論を対比している
commonTraps: by句をすべての受動文に機械的に付ける
be動詞の時制を過去分詞へ持たせようとする
否定のnotを過去分詞の後に置く
不規則過去分詞を過去形で代用する

questions.prompt: Fresh bread ------- in the hotel kitchen every morning.

choices.B: is baking

questions.translationJa: 焼きたてのパンは毎朝ホテルの厨房で焼かれます。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的な現在の受動はis＋過去分詞bakedです。

questions.prompt: The award ceremony ------- until Friday because of the storm.

choices.B: postponed something

questions.translationJa: 嵐のため授賞式は金曜日まで延期されました。
questions.explanationJa: ceremonyが延期される対象なのでwas postponedです。

questions.prompt: The contract must ------- by both parties before work begins.

choices.B: be signing

questions.translationJa: 作業開始前に契約書へ両当事者が署名しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞mustの後にbe＋過去分詞signedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The lobby mural was painted ------- students from the city art school.

choices.B: by

questions.translationJa: ロビーの壁画は市立美術学校の学生によって描かれました。
questions.explanationJa: 描いた人が重要なのでby＋行為者を加えます。

questions.prompt: The road has ------- closed since the bridge inspection began.

choices.B: being

questions.translationJa: 橋の点検開始以来、その道路は閉鎖されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動has been closedを作るbeenが必要です。

questions.prompt: It is often ------- that clear signs improve visitor safety.

choices.B: say

questions.translationJa: 明瞭な標識が来訪者の安全を高めるとよく言われます。
questions.explanationJa: 発言者を伏せるIt is often said thatの形です。

questions.prompt: The winners will be ------- by an independent judging panel.

choices.B: chosen

questions.translationJa: 受賞者は独立した審査委員会によって選ばれます。
questions.explanationJa: chooseの過去分詞chosenがwill beの後に必要です。

questions.prompt: The conference room is not ------- after 6 p.m.

choices.B: using

questions.translationJa: その会議室は午後6時以降使用されません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在受動の否定is not＋過去分詞usedです。

questions.prompt: When was the new reservation system -------?

choices.B: introduce

questions.translationJa: 新しい予約システムはいつ導入されましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 受動疑問Was＋主語＋過去分詞を完成するintroducedです。

questions.prompt: The replacement parts are being ------- at the north warehouse now.

choices.B: stored

questions.translationJa: 交換部品は現在北倉庫に保管中です。
questions.explanationJa: 現在進行受動are being＋過去分詞storedです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct passive formula.

choices.B: The monthly statements are send electronically.
choices.C: The monthly statements are sending customers electronically.
choices.D: The monthly statements are sent electronically.

questions.translationJa: 月次明細は電子的に送付されます。
questions.explanationJa: 主語＋be動詞＋過去分詞sentの公式に合っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly omits an unnecessary agent.

choices.A: The parking area will be closed by someone during resurfacing by workers.
choices.B: The parking area will be closed during resurfacing.
choices.C: The parking area will close by an unknown closer.
choices.D: Someone will be closed the parking area during resurfacing.

questions.translationJa: 再舗装中、駐車区域は閉鎖されます。
questions.explanationJa: 閉鎖する人が話題でないためby句なしの受動が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly includes a meaningful agent.

choices.A: The commemorative poster was designed from the winning student.
choices.B: The winning student was designed by the poster.
choices.C: The commemorative poster was designed by the winning student.
choices.D: The poster designed by the student was.

questions.translationJa: 記念ポスターは受賞した学生がデザインしました。
questions.explanationJa: 制作者の特定が重要なのでby句が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correctly formed passive question.

choices.B: Did the invoices were approved yesterday?

questions.translationJa: 請求書は昨日承認されましたか。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞Wereを主語前に置き過去分詞approvedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct tense marking in the passive.

choices.A: The office was cleaned every evening next year.
choices.B: The office cleaned is every evening.
choices.C: The office is clean by staff every evening when meaning an action.
choices.D: The office is cleaned every evening.

questions.translationJa: 事務所は毎晩清掃されます。
questions.explanationJa: 反復する現在の行為なのでis cleanedが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a correct negative passive.

choices.A: The access code did not changed during the test.
choices.B: The access code was changed not during the test.
choices.C: The access code was not changed during the test.
choices.D: The access code not was change during the test.

questions.translationJa: アクセスコードは試験中に変更されませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞wasの後にnot、続けて過去分詞changedを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly presents a general saying.

choices.A: It commonly says that good lighting increases productivity.
choices.B: It is commonly said that good lighting increases productivity.
choices.C: People is commonly said good lighting productivity.
choices.D: It is commonly saying that good lighting increase productivity.

questions.translationJa: 適切な照明が生産性を高めると一般に言われます。
questions.explanationJa: It is commonly said thatで話者を伏せた一般論になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct irregular participle.

choices.A: The original receipt was gave to the accounting clerk.
choices.B: The original receipt given was the clerk by.
choices.C: The receipt was giving to the clerk.
choices.D: The original receipt was given to the accounting clerk.

questions.translationJa: 原本の領収書は経理担当者へ渡されました。
questions.explanationJa: giveの過去分詞はgivenなのでwas givenが正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct future passive sentence.

choices.A: A confirmation will emailed within two business days.
choices.B: A confirmation will be email within two business days.
choices.C: A confirmation will be emailed within two business days.
choices.D: A confirmation will be emailing the customer.

questions.translationJa: 確認メールは2営業日以内に送られます。
questions.explanationJa: will be＋過去分詞emailedが未来受動を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where the agent is appropriately left unstated.

choices.A: The elevator was inspected this morning.
choices.B: The elevator was inspected by an inspector who inspected it this morning.
choices.C: An unknown someone was inspecting by the elevator.
choices.D: The elevator inspected this morning by.

questions.translationJa: エレベーターは今朝点検されました。
questions.explanationJa: 点検者が重要でないためby句を省いた簡潔な受動が適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The finalists were selected this morning.”

choices.A: Someone selected the finalists this morning.
choices.B: The finalists selected someone this morning.
choices.C: No selection took place this morning.
choices.D: The sentence identifies every judge by name.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが今朝、最終候補者を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 受動文は選ばれた対象を中心にし、行為者を省いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The display was created by local students.”

choices.B: Local students were created inside the display.
choices.C: Nobody knows whether a display exists.

questions.translationJa: 地元の学生が展示物を制作しました。
questions.explanationJa: 重要なby句の行為者を能動主語へ戻した同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Tea is grown in this region.”

choices.A: Tea grows the people who live in the region.
choices.B: The region is grown by tea producers.
choices.C: People grow tea in this region; the growers are not the focus.
choices.D: The sentence names one particular grower.

questions.translationJa: この地域では人々が茶を栽培しますが、生産者は焦点ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的生産をby句なしの受動で示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It is widely believed that the plan will succeed.”

choices.A: The plan believes many people will fail.
choices.B: Many people believe the plan will succeed.
choices.C: Only one identified person has an opinion.
choices.D: Everyone knows the plan has already failed.

questions.translationJa: 多くの人がその計画は成功すると信じています。
questions.explanationJa: 発言者を伏せた一般見解をmany peopleの能動文へ戻しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The doors are locked at nine.”

choices.A: Someone locks the doors at nine.
choices.B: The doors lock a guard at nine.
choices.C: The doors remain open after nobody acts.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが9時に扉を施錠します。
questions.explanationJa: 現在受動を不特定行為者の能動文へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The hall was decorated by volunteers.”

choices.B: Volunteers were decorations in the hall.

questions.translationJa: ボランティアが会場を飾りました。
questions.explanationJa: by句の行為者を主語にして同じ出来事を能動で表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The application has been rejected.”

choices.A: The application has rejected an employee.
choices.B: Someone is planning to approve it without review.
choices.C: The application has never received a decision.

questions.translationJa: 誰かがその申請を却下しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動をsomeone主語の能動へ戻しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Was the room reserved for Friday?”

choices.A: Did someone reserve the room for Friday?
choices.B: Did the room reserve someone for Friday?
choices.D: No one asks about a reservation.

questions.translationJa: 誰かがその部屋を金曜日に予約しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 受動疑問をsomeone主語の能動疑問へ変えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The results will be published online.”

choices.A: The results will publish a website.
choices.B: Someone will publish the results online.
choices.C: Someone published the results long ago only on paper.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが結果をオンライン公開します。
questions.explanationJa: 未来受動を不特定行為者の未来能動へ展開しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The road was closed.”

choices.A: The road closed a named official.
choices.B: The closer is the only important topic.
choices.C: Someone closed the road, but who did it is not important to the message.
choices.D: The road remained open to all traffic.

questions.translationJa: 誰かが道路を閉鎖しましたが、誰かは伝達上重要ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: by句を省いた受動は閉鎖という結果に焦点を当てます。

questions.prompt: The bakery supplies all three cafés. The pastries ------- there before sunrise.

choices.B: are prepared

questions.translationJa: そのパン屋は3軒のカフェへ供給しています。菓子は日の出前にそこで作られます。
questions.explanationJa: pastriesが作られる対象なのでare preparedです。

questions.prompt: The organizer has not named the judges. The winners will ------- at noon.

choices.B: be announcing

questions.translationJa: 主催者は審査員を公表していません。受賞者は正午に発表されます。
questions.explanationJa: 未来受動will be announcedが必要です。

questions.prompt: The artist is speaking at the reception tonight. The entrance sign was painted ------- her.

choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: その芸術家は今夜レセプションで話します。入口の看板は彼女が描きました。
questions.explanationJa: 行為者が文脈上重要なのでby herを使います。

questions.prompt: The warehouse opened only last month. More than ten thousand items have already ------- stored there.

choices.B: be

questions.translationJa: 倉庫は先月開設されたばかりですが、すでに1万点以上が保管されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動have been storedを作るbeenです。

questions.prompt: No one knows who moved the sign. It was ------- near the rear entrance.

choices.B: finding

questions.translationJa: 誰が標識を動かしたか分かりません。標識は裏口付近で見つかりました。
questions.explanationJa: 行為者不明でfindの過去分詞foundを使います。

questions.prompt: The company did not identify a spokesperson. It was ------- that refunds would begin Monday.

choices.B: stated

questions.translationJa: 会社は発言者を特定せず、返金は月曜日開始と表明されました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言者を伏せ内容を一般的に示すIt was stated thatです。

questions.prompt: The old access cards are no longer valid. They must be ------- at reception.

choices.B: return

questions.translationJa: 旧アクセスカードは無効です。受付へ返却しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: must beの後に過去分詞returnedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The gallery is closed while workers install new lights. When will it be -------?

choices.B: reopening

questions.translationJa: 作業員が新照明を設置中のためギャラリーは閉鎖されています。再開はいつですか。
questions.explanationJa: will it be＋過去分詞reopenedで未来受動疑問です。

questions.prompt: The parcel arrived with no sender information. It was not ------- by any accompanying document.

choices.B: identifying

questions.translationJa: 荷物には差出人情報がなく、同封書類でも特定されませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: was not＋過去分詞identifiedが否定受動です。

questions.prompt: The town has many bicycle lanes. It is often ------- that cycling is the easiest way to travel there.

choices.B: said

questions.translationJa: その町には自転車道が多く、自転車が最も移動しやすいとよく言われます。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的な言説をIt is often said thatで示します。
